description: Source code for the SoftVideoDecoderOMXComponent class, part of Android's media stagefright framework, implementing a software video decoder component with port configuration, parameter handling, and color aspects management.

classes.name: SoftVideoDecoderOMXComponent
classes.description: A class implementing a software video decoder component for Android's media framework, managing port configurations, color aspects, HDR info, and adaptive playback.

methods.name: InitOMXParams
methods.description: Initializes OMX parameter structures with default version info.

methods.name: SoftVideoDecoderOMXComponent::SoftVideoDecoderOMXComponent
methods.description: Constructor initializing decoder component with configuration parameters.

methods.name: initPorts
methods.description: Initializes input and output ports with buffer counts, sizes, and MIME type.

methods.name: updatePortDefinitions
methods.description: Updates port configuration details based on current settings.

methods.name: outputBufferWidth
methods.description: Calculates the output buffer width considering adaptive mode.

methods.name: outputBufferHeight
methods.description: Calculates the output buffer height considering adaptive mode.

methods.name: handlePortSettingsChange
methods.description: Handles changes in port settings, triggering resets or updates.

methods.name: dumpColorAspects
methods.description: Logs the current color aspects for debugging.

methods.name: colorAspectsDiffer
methods.description: Checks if two color aspects differ.

methods.name: updateFinalColorAspects
methods.description: Updates the final color aspects based on preferences and differences.

methods.name: handleColorAspectsChange
methods.description: Handles changes in color aspects based on user preferences.

methods.name: copyYV12FrameToOutputBuffer
methods.description: Copies YV12 formatted frame data into the output buffer.

methods.name: internalGetParameter
methods.description: Retrieves various OMX parameters such as port formats and profile levels.

methods.name: internalSetParameter
methods.description: Sets OMX parameters including component role, port formats, and adaptive playback settings.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Retrieves configuration data like crop rect and HDR info.

methods.name: getExtensionIndex
methods.description: Provides extension index for custom OMX parameters.

methods.name: supportsDescribeColorAspects
methods.description: Indicates support for describing color aspects.

methods.name: getColorAspectPreference
methods.description: Returns user preference for color aspect handling.

methods.name: supportDescribeHdrStaticInfo
methods.description: Indicates support for HDR static info description.

methods.name: supportDescribeHdr10PlusInfo
methods.description: Indicates support for HDR10+ info description.

methods.name: onReset
methods.description: Resets internal state of the component.

methods.name: onPortEnableCompleted
methods.description: Handles completion of port enabling/disabling.

methods.name: dequeueInputFrameConfig
methods.description: Dequeues the next input frame configuration buffer.

methods.name: queueOutputFrameConfig
methods.description: Queues an output frame configuration buffer.
